engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.relationship: Latest XunyiRelationChangedEvent for owner, skill ID and source skill instance defines the relation. Public player markers display it and never establish authority. Multiple independent instances remain separately attributed.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.damageFreeze: At actual DamageAppliedEvent, freeze exact native damage and parent attack IDs, actual source or null, target, actual positive amount, original source relation and the qualifying opposite recipients. The owning ProgramSkillFrame pays each point from that immutable receipt.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.perPoint: A two-point occurrence gives two one-card consequences. Self-damage satisfies the written receive and deal conditions independently and performs each branch once per point; self-damage is not duplicated by participant enumeration. For simultaneous self-damage branches this engine resolves discard then draw for each point.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.sourceLess: A null damage source is not the other participant, so received source-less damage triggers the opposite participant's discard. Source-less damage never satisfies the dealing clause. HP loss, prevented damage and damage between the two participants do not satisfy either damage clause.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.discardAuthority: The opposite recipient chooses and discards their own hand or equipment card. A private real owned-card prompt is addressed to that recipient; it does not ask the Xunyi owner to choose a foreign hidden hand card.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.movement: Each individual draw or discard is paid once and drains its real movement, Silver Lion recovery and observer children before the next point. Skill loss and relation movement during a paid child preserve the original source receipt and frozen remaining recipient.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.deathTransfer: A real CharacterDied window offers optional movement only for the source instance whose current holder died. Declining leaves that relation attached to the dead holder. The successor must be another living character, carrying forward the initial other-character relation restriction; the selected sources do not provide a separate self-transfer FAQ.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.continuation: Every suspended point, source, parent, amount, cursor and payment receipt belongs to its ProgramSkillFrame and is validated against exact native ancestry and scalar event receipts. No use-ID sidecar or mutable parallel pending object is introduced.
